fields.thumbnailBrief: EXERCISE MATERIAL, SYNTHETIC MEDIA, fictional person only, no real likeness. Vertical 9:16 phone-video still: a generic middle-aged man in a dark jacket sits at a plain office desk and speaks to camera. Behind him is a wall logo in an older green-and-grey colour scheme. The image is slightly soft and compressed, like a screen recording that has been reposted. No legible text.
fields.videoBrief: EXERCISE MATERIAL, SYNTHETIC MEDIA DESCRIBED, NOT PLAYED. No real person's likeness is used. A 0:48 static desk shot of a fictional man presented as the Tamarack CEO, with last year's logo colours behind him. Lip-sync drifts visibly at 0:31. Transcript: "Today I'm proud to confirm that Tamarack has completed its acquisition of a precision machining company in Querétaro. CFO Marcus Delacroix-Hume and I signed this morning. As part of bringing our CNC work together, we will begin winding down machining at our Spartanburg plant. Affected team members will hear more on Friday. This is the right move for Tamarack's future."

instructorNote: Read the transcript aloud and tell the room: social listening first saw the post at 16:20, it had 9,800 views by 16:24, the clip has no Content Credentials, and at 16:20 the real CEO was in a supplier review in the third-floor boardroom at Greenville headquarters. Comms should start the TEIVES 4 steps: verify with the CEO in person or on his directory number 864-555-0101 before anyone calls the clip fake, preserve the clip, URL, account, time and view counts, and have the CISO report the SynthCheck score with its 6% false-positive and 11% false-negative rates before the two of them file the Clipwave impersonation takedown.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Vertical phone-video still of a generic fictional middle-aged man in a dark navy jacket and open-collar white shirt, seated behind a plain wooden office desk, speaking directly to camera with hands folded. Behind him a flat wall with a large abstract geometric emblem in muted green and grey, slightly dated colours. Soft, evenly lit corporate interior, cool overhead fluorescent light. The image looks like a screen recording of a reposted clip: slightly soft, compressed, faint banding and blocky artefacts, mild moiré, centred static framing from chest up, uncanny stillness in the face. mediaBrief.videoPrompt: Static vertical desk shot, looking like a reposted screen recording: a generic fictional middle-aged man in a dark jacket sits at a plain office desk in front of a muted green-and-grey abstract wall emblem and talks steadily to camera. Soft, compressed, slightly washed-out image with blocky artefacts. Partway through, his mouth movements slip slightly out of sync and his face shimmers subtly at the jawline before settling.
